title: Peace for the road ahead
text: Be still, and know that I am God. As you walk, breathe slowly. Christ walks with you. You do not have to hurry your heart. (Psalm 46:10)

title: Held, not hurried
text: Come to me, all who are weary, and I will give you rest. Let each step remind you: you are carried by grace, not by your own strength. (Matthew 11:28)

title: The Lord is my shepherd
text: The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want. He makes me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside still waters. He restores my soul. (Psalm 23:1-3)
kjv: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want. He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still waters. He restoreth my soul. (Psalm 23:1-3, KJV)
web: Yahweh is my shepherd: I shall lack nothing. He makes me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside still waters. He restores my soul. (Psalm 23:1-3, WEB)
asv: Jehovah is my shepherd; I shall not want. He maketh me to lie down in green pastures; He leadeth me beside still waters. He restoreth my soul: He guideth me in the paths of righteousness for his name's sake. (Psalm 23:1-3, ASV)

title: Cast your cares
text: Cast all your anxiety on him because he cares for you. Name one worry with each breath, and leave it with Jesus as you walk on. (1 Peter 5:7)

title: Peace I leave with you
text: Peace I leave with you; my peace I give to you. Not as the world gives do I give to you. Let not your hearts be troubled, neither let them be afraid. (John 14:27)
kjv: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid. (John 14:27, KJV)
web: Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you; not as the world gives, give I to you. Don't let your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful. (John 14:27, WEB)
asv: Peace I leave with you; my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful. (John 14:27, ASV)

title: Gentle and lowly
text: Jesus is gentle and lowly in heart. He does not crush the bruised reed. Bring him your tiredness exactly as it is; he receives you with kindness. (Matthew 12:20)

title: Be still
text: Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted in the earth! (Psalm 46:10)
kjv: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth. (Psalm 46:10, KJV)
web: Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations. I will be exalted in the earth. (Psalm 46:10, WEB)
asv: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted in the earth. (Psalm 46:10, ASV)

title: He restores my soul
text: When your soul feels thin, remember the Shepherd restores. Rest is not laziness; it is trust. Walk slowly and let him refill you. (Psalm 23:3)

title: Do not fear
text: Fear not, for I am with you; be not dismayed, for I am your God; I will strengthen you, I will help you, I will uphold you with my righteous right hand. (Isaiah 41:10)
kjv: Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God: I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness. (Isaiah 41:10, KJV)
web: Don't you be afraid, for I am with you. Don't be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help you. Yes, I will uphold you with the right hand of my righteousness. (Isaiah 41:10, WEB)
asv: Fear thou not, for I am with thee; be not dismayed, for I am thy God; I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness. (Isaiah 41:10, ASV)

title: Quiet waters
text: He leads me beside still waters. If your day is loud, let this moment be quiet water. Listen more than you speak, and rest in his presence. (Psalm 23:2)
